Fast terminal response excludes ActivationUnverified; 2009–2029 only excludes pending AgentInbox, so promotion 2132–2145 before lookup returns empty controls, PendingJob, and passes alert eligibility. Warm verified presence hint, old writer enabled, exact Ready episode with unresolved sent launch, queued STOP and same actor ordinary call suffice. 430–455 then takes queue on verified snapshot; ReviewWorkflow.fs2672–2693 commits DeliverResponseAlerts clearing queue + version increment before returning text; no launch predicate in transaction. Base Client.fs479–506 checked guardUncorrelatedIngressAt before consumption (not atomic with CAS; avoid restoring this global admission design). ScheduledReadyResume.fs76–104 readReady rejects pending STOP, stillReadyAt565–568, confirmedActivationAt597–614, recordCheckinOnce629–668 use it, so after consume, later valid launch check-in/activation can pass if other fences hold. Race source-proven conditional, no observed production activation from this race; supervised trial on base was different liveness defect, scheduler cancelled.
SCOPE: original spec v2 explicitly says independent admission, preserve STOP for effects to which it applies, actual check-in/activation CAS and replacement, and distinguish refused activation from admission. No new threat model, identity credential or blanket ingress restriction. IMPACT: realistic concurrent prior/manual request plus delayed ledger fetch/promotion during unresolved launch; lost STOP safety fence permits scheduled execution despite Operator hold. Not a claim of process termination guarantee.
PRACTICALITY/ALTERNATIVES: existing docs/ResponseAlerts.md states pending visible handles MAY carry alerts and at-most-once consume before return, no ack or proof of obedience; blanket activatesAgent suppression for all pending handles unnecessarily delays STOP for already Working agents (especially long promoted jobs whose polls intentionally do not consume in current candidate). Docs still mention poll delivery, but current source/existing tests at Client.Tests/ReviewWorkflowTests.fs7858–7968,7974–8024 explicitly require non-consuming polling, immutable background result and next eligible visible ordinary reply delivery; preserve candidate control contract, not stale docs wording. Prefer a small response-side STOP preservation predicate at existing queue CAS using latest verified snapshot and existing exact Ready/unresolved launch predicate (e.g. pass guard from caller to guarded takeResponseAlertsAt, avoid module dependency cycle). Only if queue contains STOP and unresolved exact Ready launch, leave queue/version untouched; fail closed for uncertainty on that consumption, not command admission. Apply to same response-consumption seam for pending and terminal eligible responses so a non-activating ordinary terminal response cannot bypass identical STOP fence. No extra scheduled guard fetch for unrelated/no-alert commands, no new role or identity exceptions, no weaken check-in/CAS/replacement, no permanent STOP or ack redesign. Existing all-or-nothing queue may be retained; do not require splitting non-STOP alerts. Preserve eligible pending Working/no fenced Ready alert delivery, terminal eligible alert delivery, rejected/unknown activation suppression as appropriate, no new consumption on background completion or job controls. A blanket pending suppression alone is insufficient to preserve existing eligible pending Working delivery and would not cover other same-queue consumption paths. Alternative equivalent narrow remedy acceptable if same invariant and control semantics proven. Residual risk explicitly existing one-shot alert loss/actor advisory outside exact unresolved Ready STOP condition; no claim of execution termination.
REGRESSION: frozen candidate integration fixture using actual executeOrPromoteWith and real ordinary registered LifecycleHistory dispatch with deterministic barrier before activation lookup, verified pending alert presence (reconcileResponseAlerts), Ready exact unresolved launch with send boundary and STOP queued. Assert pending handle returned, no STOP control or DeliverResponseAlerts, exact alert ID/content/queue version and Ready episode unchanged. Release barrier; terminal result admitted with ActivationUnverified (no Seen or activation), polls return pending/terminal original without consumption/replay. Before STOP explicit clear, exact correlated launch cannot check in/activate (cover both no check-in and previously confirmed check-in variants), no replacement or activation receipt; clear by exact authorized operation and positive exact correlated activation once in independent fixture/valid deadline. Compare fast terminal path; exercise eligible nonactivating ordinary response under same STOP fence and already Working/unfenced pending and terminal ordinary response controls, normal alert delivery exactly once including applicable errors, no background/poll alert loss or replay. Test queue-CAS race where launch becomes unresolved before consume, with deterministic barrier if using guarded CAS; retain old-writer and queue CAS failures. No production edits, builds, tests, deploy, review mutation, launch replay performed.
